description: This file contains common declarations, structures, macros, and function prototypes for dialog modules using ncurses, including UI element definitions, color settings, and item management functions.

classes.name: dialog_color
classes.description: Structure defining color attributes for dialog UI elements.

classes.name: subtitle_list
classes.description: Linked list structure for managing subtitles.

classes.name: dialog_info
classes.description: Structure holding dialog window configuration and color schemes.

classes.name: dialog_item
classes.description: Structure representing a menu or checklist item.

methods.name: item_make
methods.description: Creates a new item with formatted string.

methods.name: item_add_str
methods.description: Adds a string to the item list.

methods.name: item_set_tag
methods.description: Sets the tag for the current item.

methods.name: item_set_data
methods.description: Associates data pointer with current item.

methods.name: item_set_selected
methods.description: Marks the current item as selected or not.

methods.name: item_data
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with current item.

methods.name: item_tag
methods.description: Gets the tag of the current item.

methods.name: item_str
methods.description: Returns prompt string of current item.

methods.name: item_is_selected
methods.description: Checks if current item is selected.

methods.name: item_is_tag
methods.description: Checks if current item has specified tag.

methods.name: first_alpha
methods.description: Finds first alphabetic character in string.

methods.name: dialog_textbox
methods.description: Displays a text box with scroll.
